title: ModernTex 3.0: hear your manuscript, and dictate into LaTeX
note: dur = seconds of the clip used. appAudio: the capture's own read-aloud audio plays at full level and narration stays silent. narration scenes are voiced by narrate.py; captions are burned in.

scenes.cap: You have read this paragraph ten times.
scenes.narration: You have read this paragraph ten times. Listen to it instead.

scenes.cap: Pause. Back a sentence. Forward a sentence.
scenes.narration: Pause, skip back a sentence, skip forward, and carry on.

scenes.cap: Captions are read. Tables are summarised from their own source.

scenes.narration: Stop, and it remembers where you were. Press again and it carries on from there.

scenes.cap: A repeated word is easier to hear than to see.
Speak. It lands in your source, safe for LaTeX.
scenes.narration: Dictation puts what you say into the source. The percent sign is escaped for you, and spoken punctuation works.

scenes.cap: One Undo removes the whole passage.
scenes.narration: One undo takes the whole passage back out.

scenes.cap: Both run on your Mac. Nothing is sent off it.
scenes.narration: Both run on your Mac. Nothing is sent off it. ModernTex 3.0 is a free update for owners.
